newsitem.title: USA: Anadarko sees production at 76 mln bbls.
newsitem.headline: Anadarko sees production at 76 mln bbls.

text.p: Anadarko Petroleum Corp expects to produce 76 million barrels of oil equivalent per year by 2000, up from the 38 million produced last year, senior vice president for exploration John Seitz said Tuesday.
In 1997, he continued, output is expected to be 44 million barrels of oil equivalent, all from U.S. production.
"In the output total for the year 2000, we have only included discoveries already made," he told PaineWebber's annual energy conference.
By the year 2000, he added, oil production revenues will account for half the company's total revenues.
At present, natural gas produces two-third's of Anadarko's revenues.
Seitz also noted that by 1999, oil reserves will be larger than natural gas reserves. At present, they are split about 50-50. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
